column1: # Permitted instrument patterns for the GMI Trade Memo app.
# One pattern per line. '*' is a wildcard. Matching is case-insensitive.
# This file is meant to be maintained by the instructor each semester.
# - Exact tickers (e.g. "SPY US Equity") only match that one instrument.
# - Root wildcards (e.g. "GC* Comdty") match any contract-month/year suffix
#   which futures need since the front contract rolls every semester.
# - "* Curncy" / "* Index" are left open since FX crosses and benchmark
#   whitelisting the way single stocks do.
# - Corp/Govt/Muni/CDS instruments are intentionally NOT whitelisted here;
#   validation.py routes those to manual instructor review instead.
